scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web,lab --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "uv run --directory lab python -m lab.api || echo lab service exited - charting keeps running"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix web run test && uv run --directory lab pytest -q
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
